description: This bar chart illustrates the performance of two models, LLaMA-3-8B-it and “Ours (Iterative RLHF)”, across several datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis represents the “Dataset and Metrics”, with categories labeled eSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBpp, LC-AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Score (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. For each dataset, there are two bars representing each model; the LLaMA-3-8B-it model is represented by blue bars, and the “Ours (Iterative RLHF)” model is represented by orange bars. The eSM-8K dataset shows the tallest bars, with “Ours (Iterative RLHF)” reaching approximately 79% and LLaMA-3-8B-it reaching approximately 73%. The Chat-Arena-Hard dataset shows the shortest bars, with “Ours (Iterative RLHF)” reaching approximately 16% and LLaMA-3-8B-it reaching approximately 11%. The bars are arranged in pairs, one blue and one orange, for each dataset, and no bars are visually emphasized.
